conversation.text: Anything that would make next week easier?

Things are going well overall! One small thing that would help is a one-page list of who to ask for what (IT, payroll, SAP access). I spent an hour last week just trying to figure out who resets SAP passwords.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire requested a reference list to easily identify contacts for IT, payroll, and system access needs. [ONBOARDING_TRAINING] "One small thing that would help is a one-page list of who to ask for what (IT, payroll, SAP access)."
